text:
QUOTE: "If viewable, archive sets `delete_at` locally via `setChannelDeleteAt` and keeps the channel in the sidebar. If not, the user is removed from the channel locally" and "On a channel-deleted event: if not viewable, kick the user out of the current channel (`Events.CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`) and remove membership. If viewable, only the `delete_at` is stored."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when not viewable the user is removed (and kicked out if current channel), and when viewable the channel is kept with delete_at set (marked deleted).
